description: This file implements the onboarding wizard feature in a macOS application, including a view and a model to manage wizard steps, state, and interactions with external services such as gateway and logging.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardModel
classes.description: A view model class adhering to the Observable protocol, managing the state and logic of the onboarding wizard, including starting, submitting steps, canceling, and handling errors.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardStepView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that renders individual wizard steps and handles user input for different step types such as text, select, multiselect, and confirmation.

methods.name: bridgeToLocal
methods.description: Converts a ProtocolAnyCodable value to an internal AnyCodable type, decoding JSON data to avoid type conflicts.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates the wizard process if certain conditions are met, handling gateway readiness and starting the wizard session.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the user's response to a wizard step to the backend.

methods.name: applyStartResult
methods.description: Updates internal state based on the result of starting the wizard.

methods.name: applyNextResult
methods.description: Updates internal state based on the result of moving to the next wizard step.

methods.name: applyStatusResult
methods.description: Updates internal state based on the current status result.

methods.name: restartIfSessionLost
methods.description: Handles session loss errors by attempting to restart the wizard session if conditions allow.

methods.name: shouldSkipWizard
methods.description: Checks configuration or authentication state to determine if the wizard should be skipped.
